source.mission: Mars Science Laboratory / Curiosity, Gale Crater

source_locator: Reitz et al., ICES-2016-437, abstract on PDF page 2 and Figure 3 caption on PDF page 6; surface dose equivalent, not cruise rate.
source_observation_period: 2012-08-07 through 2013-06-01; historical Gale Crater measurements summarized by the authors.
uncertainty_description: Published plus/minus rate is used only as a sensitivity half-width. It is not a validated confidence interval or worst-case bound for Jezero, solar events, shielding or human organ dose.
assumptions: Replay a constant historical RAD dose-equivalent rate for the supplied duration; day means 24 Earth hours, not a Martian sol.
Applying the Gale Crater rate to a Jezero-labeled scenario is an explicit hypothetical transfer, not a measured Jezero rate.
The 1440-minute duration cap is a demonstration scope choice, not a validated EVA duration or biological exposure limit.
limitations: No current solar-event forecast, solar-cycle correction, altitude/pressure transfer, spacecraft/suit shielding correction or organ-dose model is supplied.
Published uncertainty does not quantify the additional uncertainty of transferring location, epoch or shielding conditions.
The downloaded sol-1 absorbed-dose product is inspected separately; it is not used to calculate or calibrate this literature scenario.
No per-cell radiation raster or terrain-risk reduction is supplied; a scenario budget pass is not an astronaut safety determination.
